categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.
categories.conformance: Workflow-owned material the frozen v2.3.1 test suite reads but a target repository does not need in order to operate the Workflow. Carried in the payload, installed only under the 'full' profile.
categories.host-evidence: Upstream host-repository documents the frozen v2.3.1 test suite asserts on. Retained verbatim as an execution fixture for the frozen suite only; never installed into a target repository.
categories.template: Repository-local state whose upstream instance is RepFlow's live state. Never copied; a clean initial template is generated instead.
categories.repo-local-state: Repository-local runtime/work-item state. Never migrated in any form; a managed target creates its own.
categories.historical: Upstream evidence/history that neither the Workflow implementation nor its tests require. Deliberately excluded.
categories.upstream-specific: RepFlow application/product material. Never part of the generic distribution.

rules.rationale: Canonical Workflow implementation modules; every command entry point names them.
The real bundle-generation boundary every review-stage command drives as a subprocess.
The v2.3.1 conformance suite. CI-gated upstream; it is the Workflow's own executable specification and ships with it.
The executable command contract; workflow_state.py's state-writer census enumerates this directory.
Operator-facing contract documents; commands route to them and the frozen suite lints them against the code.
The normative design document. Commands cite it, workflow_state.py parses its 'Missing tests' section, and the dry-run verifiers parse its raw-edge table.
The lifecycle diagram; workflow_integration_test.py parses its embedded drawio model against the phase tables.
Repository-level Workflow config. Upstream content is a valid default but is repository-local state by contract (fingerprint excludes it from plan-stage classification); regenerated as a template.
Live RepFlow work-item state (4 work items, real commit SHAs). Never migrated; a clean empty state is generated.
Loaded by name and executed by workflow_state_test.py's TestDryRunVerifiers; the suite fails without them. Path depth is load-bearing (they resolve repo root via parents[3]).
workflow_integration_test.py lints WORKFLOW_V2_PLAN.md's WFR table row-for-row against this file; also a PLAN_STAGE_PROTECTED path.
The salvage-audit record the acceptance matrix and defect ledger rows are named from; referenced by the suite's docstrings and by the operator reference.
The Workflow's own design/audit history for the v2.1->v2.3 line; PLAN_STAGE_PROTECTED names WORKFLOW_V2_AUDIT.md, and the operator docs cross-reference all four.
Registry/mapping/artifact declarations for the Workflow's own completed process work items. Terminal (MILESTONE_COMPLETE), never live state; kept so the Workflow's own history stays self-describing.
Declarations for the synthetic v2-1-dry-run work item. No test reads them (probed: removable).
RepFlow product milestone artifact declaration.
Manual dry-run findings, scratch inputs and the WF8b-S14 reproduction harness. Evidence of how v2.1 defects were found; no test loads them (probed: removable).
Host-repository agent guidance. workflow_integration_test.py's LIVE_DOCS lint reads it; PLAN_STAGE_EXCLUDED_PATHS names it. Content is RepFlow-specific, so it is a fixture, not a distribution file.

FUNCTIONAL_CHECKLIST_PATH by contract, but the upstream instance is 1857 lines of RepFlow milestone narrative that two frozen tests assert dated paragraphs of. Fixture only; targets get a clean template.

Bundle/runtime workspace. Git-ignored upstream and absent from the tag; a target creates its own. Never tracked at the frozen commit (git-ignored upstream), so this rule intentionally matches nothing; it exists so the category is stated rather than silent.
RepFlow agent instructions (Gradle/Android commands). Not read by any suite (probed: removable).
RepFlow product README.
Upstream file is Android/Gradle-specific; the Workflow needs only its '.ai-review/' and Python entries, which the installer merges into the target's own .gitignore.
Carries the seven Workflow suite jobs interleaved with RepFlow's Gradle jobs. The Workflow-owned jobs are emitted as a standalone template workflow; the upstream file is not copied.
RepFlow Copilot rule sources and product prompts.
RepFlow product milestone execution/reference documents.
RepFlow architecture decisions, agent-context benchmarks and improvement roadmaps.

RepFlow product documents. Named in PLAN_STAGE_PROTECTED/EXCLUDED as workflow-v2-1-core's own frozen path sets, which v2.3.1 keeps only as historical fixtures (see fingerprint.py's OPUS-R28-011 note).
Android/Gradle build system and RepFlow application sources.
